technical-summary: Found by RCS13 A/B runs 6 and 7. Lane buffer allocation and worker_footprint.h now share one sizing helper (60 B per lane drift made the TP2 helper refuse to start, #1056). The Python planner honours the C++ exit-11 host-pool remeasure contract, and the S10 resolver no longer rewrites the helper VRAM budget after the engine measured the owner map, failing closed instead (#1058).
user-summary-candidate: Flash-Next TP2 helpers start again and the measured-manifest planner remeasures the host pool as the serving contract requires.
